descriptionPlain:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
The Account Director is responsible for overseeing one or more customers and teams, ensuring the delivery of honest, reliable services with transparency and clarity. They act as a strategic partner, offering innovative solutions when technology alone may not meet a customer’s goals. Collaborating closely with internal teams, the Account Director plays a key role in driving both customer and employee success. Through proactive leadership, clear communication, and a commitment to excellence, they foster strong relationships that support long-term growth and satisfaction for all stakeholders.
 
This role is expected to be office based at least 2-3 days a week.

The Role

The Account Director is responsible for overseeing one or more customers and teams, ensuring the delivery of honest, reliable services with transparency and clarity. They act as a strategic partner, offering innovative solutions when technology alone may not meet a customer’s goals. Collaborating closely with internal teams, the Account Director plays a key role in driving both customer and employee success. This role is expected to be office based at least 2-3 days a week.

lists.content:
• Relationship Management
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for customer stakeholders, ensuring swift issue resolution
  • Develop and maintain strong, long-term customer relationships that foster trust, advocacy, and sustained business growth
  • Participate in customer meetings (weekly, monthly, quarterly) to align on goals and objectives
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities with existing and potential customers
  • Service Excellence & Strategic Guidance
  • Ensure teams successfully deliver on customer requests and objectives, including reporting, technology updates, and service execution
  • Provide strategic guidance on industry best practices to enhance customer operations
  • Maintain a deep understanding of life sciences, regulated environments, event planning, and speakers bureau operations to provide expert-level service
  • Stay up to date with relevant industry regulations, such as OIG guidelines and the PhRMA Code, ensuring compliance and high-quality service delivery
  • Continuously seek ways to improve processes and enhance the overall customer experience
  • Team & Operational Management
  • Build, mentor, and develop internal teams, fostering professional growth and high performance
  • Manage staffing within budget constraints for various customer structures, collaborating with internal teams to ensure appropriate resourcing
  • Oversee Statements of Work (SOWs) and ensure project scopes are effectively managed

• B.S. or B.A. degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of customer service or account management or operations
  • 3+ years of personnel development and leadership
  • Prior experience within Life Sciences,  Speakers Bureau, and Event Planning
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Professional and clear oral and written communication
  • Demonstrate ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and/or multitask often to meet fluctuating customer/company priorities
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

• Familiar with the Life Science industry
  • Maintain current knowledge of appropriate regulations, e.g., OIG, PhRMA Code
  • Fundamental knowledge of Veeva Commercial CRM Product Suite including but not limited to Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault, Events Management, and Engage
  • Ability to work and thrive in a team atmosphere
  • Positive attitude and maintain a “Whatever it Takes” attitude
  • A strong  customer focus
  • A servant leader

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $95,000 - $140,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
We are hiring an Account Manager for LearnGxP to drive the growth of Veeva’s accredited GxP eLearning library in the life sciences industry. In this role, you’ll drive your own success by generating sales demand and pipeline revenue through outbound lead development. You will own the end-to-end sales process, including generating leads, qualifying opportunities, closing deals, and collaborating with Veeva account executives. 
 
You will also act as a strategic partner and cultivate strong customer relationships by shaping market messaging, providing thought leadership, and facilitating customer adoption of the Veeva LearnGxP offering to promote long-term success. Leveraging your expertise in sales, life sciences, and online learning, you’ll develop innovative solutions to meet customer needs and promote rapid growth in digital training.

In this role, you’ll drive your own success by generating sales demand and pipeline revenue through outbound lead development. You will own the end-to-end sales process, including generating leads, qualifying opportunities, closing deals, and collaborating with Veeva account executives.

lists.content:
• Work within a defined territory to generate and qualify new leads and sales pipeline opportunities
  • Research and develop a plan for selling LearnGxP into your assigned accounts
  • Manage the complete sales cycle and build trusted customer relationships
  • Understand the catalog of GxP courseware and be able to speak about it with authority
  • Collaborate with Veeva Account Partners to advance and close your opportunities
  • Maintain accurate activity and opportunity tracking in CRM
  • Deliver solution-oriented responses for RFPs, proposals, and presentations
  • Configure and manage customer trial accounts
  • Drive growth in the US market for Veeva training solutions 
  • Represent Veeva at industry events

• 3+ years of life sciences experience
  • Proven ability to innovate across business processes and technology solutions
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage customer stakeholders on GxP eLearning content across multiple functional areas
  • Energetic self-starter with excellent time management, prioritization, and initiative
  • Team player with accountability and adaptability to take direction
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • A background in GxP and learning & development (L&D)
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems and eLearning solutions, ideally in pre-sales or customer-facing roles within software or training companies
  • Ambitious and driven to succeed in a dynamic environment
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% for customer meetings and presentations

• Experience in Consulting, Customer Success, or Project Management
  • Experience with Veeva, Salesforce or other CRM systems
  • Experience in Life Sciences or Technology 
  • Strategic account planning and execution skills
  • Knowledge of eLearning best practices, standards and current industry trends, with a particular focus on life sciences or GxP applicability
  • Learning Management System experience

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $70,500 - $100,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
